definition.def: If you differentiate between things or if you differentiate one thing from another, you recognize or show the difference between them.
examples: A child may not differentiate between his imagination and the real world. [V + between]
At this age your baby cannot differentiate one person from another. [VERB noun + from]

definition.def: A quality or feature that differentiates one thing from another makes the two things different.
examples: ...distinctive policies that differentiate them from the other parties. [VERB noun + from]

definition.def: the act of recognizing or showing that two things are not the same
examples: There needs to be a clear differentiation between communal and private areas of the house.

definition.def: treatment of people or things in different ways, especially unfairly
examples: a policy that makes no differentiation among ethnic groups

definition.def: the process of a cell becoming different during growth and development
examples: The proteins of a cell may change during differentiation.

examples.sentence: They also had to create product differentiation.
